title: 第2章 七天一修炼
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
第二天下午，林尘准时到了寒月阁。

    玉玲珑已经等着了。

    她还是那身白裙，但看他的眼神跟昨天不一样了。

    带着一种审视，还有一种说不清的情绪。

    像是犹豫，又像是下定了某种决心。

    “进来。”

    林尘跟她进了屋。

    这次她没坐蒲团，直接走到玉床前。

    香炉里的香换了，是一种他从来没闻过的药香，带着淡淡的甜味。

    “师尊，今天需要弟子做什么？”

    玉玲珑转过身看着他。

    她的表情很冷静，但手指微微攥紧了袖口。

    “为师要检查你的修炼进度。”

    “怎么检查？”

    “把上衣脱了。”

    林尘眨了眨眼。

    “师尊，你检查修炼进度就检查修炼进度，脱衣服干嘛。”

    “闭嘴。”

    她脸上闪过一丝不自然。

    “为师怀疑你体质有异，需要仔细探查。昨天只是握手就能让为师的灵力活跃，说明你的体质不是普通天赋。今天要做更全面的检查。”

    林尘慢悠悠脱下外衣，露出上身。

    这具身体瘦了吧唧的，一看就是炼气三层的废柴体质。

    肋骨都能数清楚，胳膊上没什么肌肉，肤色因为常年不晒太阳反而偏白。

    玉玲珑走到他面前，抬起一只手按在他胸口。

    她的手心很热，跟昨天完全不一样。

    “闭上眼，放松。为师用灵力走一遍你的经脉，不要抵抗。”

    林尘照做了。

    一股灵力从她手心渗入他体内，在经脉中游走。

    那感觉很奇怪，像被什么东西轻轻扫过。

    从胸口开始，沿着任脉往下，经过丹田，再转入督脉往上。

    然后，他感觉体内的灵力开始涌动。

    那不是他的灵力，他炼气三层能有多少灵力。

    那是身体深处某股沉睡的力量，被她这一刺激，醒了。

    那股力量从丹田最深处涌出来，像被压了无数年的泉水忽然找到了出口，沿着她的灵力引导一路往上冲。

    “嘶——”

    玉玲珑倒吸一口凉气。

    林尘睁开眼，看见她满脸震惊地盯着他，按在他胸口的那只手都在微微发抖。

    “混沌圣体……竟然真的有这种体质……”

    她喃喃自语，声音小得像在说梦话。

    眼眶已经开始泛红，是那股力量冲击的余波。

    “师尊说的是什么。”

    她回过神来，收回手，深吸了好几口气，才让表情恢复平静。

    但那双眼睛里依然波光粼粼。

    “林尘，你的体质很特殊。特殊到整个修仙界都会为之疯狂。”

    “这么厉害。”

    “不止是厉害。”

    她顿了顿，声音变得低沉。

    “这种体质，和你双修的女修，无论什么境界，都能获得巨大的增益。突破瓶颈，治愈暗伤，提升修为——你都能做到。刚才为师只是用灵力探查，体内的暗伤就松动了一处。六年来为师试过无数方法想要修复左肩那道暗伤，都无济于事。你只是站在那里让为师探查灵力，就胜过为师六年的努力。”

    林尘装出一副惊讶的样子。

    “这么强。”

    “强是强，但对你来说，未必是好事。”

    玉玲珑神色复杂。

    “这种体质一旦暴露，你会被各大势力争抢，到时候就不是修炼的事，而是能不能活下来的问题了。没人会把你当人看，你只会被当成一件能让人突破的工具。”

    “那师尊打算怎么办。”

    她沉默了很久。

    林尘看着她，等着。

    她站在那里一动不动，只有手指在微微发抖。

    终于，她开口了，声音有点哑。

    “为师困在金丹后期已经六年了。六年间用了无数方法，服了无数丹药，始终无法突破。左肩的暗伤是六年前跟人交手时留下的，这些年不但没好，反而越来越重。丹田的灵气运转也越来越滞涩。”

    “再这样下去，为师的道途就到头了。”

    她抬起头，直直盯着他。

    “林尘，为师需要你的帮助。”

    “弟子当然愿意帮师尊，只是……”

    林尘顿了顿。

    “师尊说的帮助，是指双修吗。”

    玉玲珑的脸微微红了。

    她习惯了高冷的形象，在苍梧宗当了二十年长老，从来都是别人毕恭毕敬地跟她说话。

    现在要亲口说出那种话，确实有点为难她。

    “是。”
content_en:
In the afternoon of the next day, Lin Chen arrived at Hanyue Pavilion on time.

    Yu Linglong is already waiting.

    She was still wearing the same white dress, but the way she looked at him was different from yesterday.

    With a kind of scrutiny and an indescribable emotion.

    It seemed like hesitation, but also like he had made some kind of determination.

    "Come in."

    Lin Chen followed her into the house.

    This time she didn't sit on the futon and walked directly to the jade bed.

    The incense in the incense burner was changed. It was a medicinal fragrance that he had never smelled before, with a faint sweetness.

    "Master, what do you need me to do today?"

    Yu Linglong turned around and looked at him.

    Her expression was calm, but her fingers clenched her cuffs slightly.

    "My teacher wants to check your cultivation progress."

    "How to check?"

    "Take off your shirt."

    Lin Chen blinked.

    "Master, you just check the progress of your cultivation. Why are you taking off your clothes?"

    "Shut up."

    A trace of uneasiness flashed across her face.

    "My master suspects that your physique is different, and we need to investigate it carefully. Just shaking hands yesterday made my master's spiritual energy active, which shows that your physique is not an ordinary talent. Today we need to do a more comprehensive examination."

    Lin Chen slowly took off his coat, exposing his upper body.

    This body is so thin that it looks like a loser at the third level of Qi Refining.

    You can count your ribs clearly, there are no muscles in your arms, and your skin color is white because you haven't been exposed to the sun all year round.

    Yu Linglong walked up to him, raised a hand and pressed it on his chest.

    Her palms were very hot, completely different from yesterday.

    "Close your eyes and relax. Let me use my spiritual power to go through your meridians, don't resist."

    Lin Chen did as he was told.

    A stream of spiritual power seeped into his body from the palm of her hand and traveled through his meridians.

    It felt strange, like being brushed by something.

    Start from the chest, go down along the Ren channel, pass through the Dantian, and then turn to the Du channel and go up.

    Then, he felt the spiritual energy in his body begin to surge.

    That's not his spiritual power. How much spiritual power can he have at the third level of Qi refining?

    It was a sleeping force deep in the body, which was awakened by her stimulation.

    The power surged out from the deepest part of Dantian, like spring water that had been suppressed for countless years and suddenly found an outlet, rushing upward along the guidance of her spiritual power.

    "Hiss——"

    Yu Linglong took a breath of cold air.

    Lin Chen opened his eyes and saw her staring at him with shock on her face, and the hand pressing on his chest was trembling slightly.

    "The Holy Body of Chaos... actually has this kind of physique..."

    She murmured to herself, her voice so low it sounded like she was talking in her sleep.

    The eye sockets have begun to turn red, which is the aftermath of the impact of that force.

    "What did the master say?"

    She came to her senses, retracted her hand, and took several deep breaths before her expression returned to calm.

    But those eyes were still sparkling.

    "Lin Chen, your physique is very special. So special that the entire world of immortality will go crazy for it."

    "So awesome."

    "More than awesome."

    She paused and her voice became deeper.

    "With this kind of physique, a female cultivator like you can achieve huge gains no matter what state you are in. Break through bottlenecks, heal hidden wounds, and improve your cultivation level - you can do it. Just now, I just used my spiritual power to detect the hidden wounds in my body, and the hidden wounds in my body were loosened. In the past six years, I have tried countless methods to repair the hidden wounds on my left shoulder, but to no avail. You just stood there and let me detect your spiritual power, which is better than my six years of hard work."

    Lin Chen pretended to be surprised.

    "So strong."

    "Strong is strong, but it may not be a good thing for you."

    Yu Linglong's expression was complicated.

    "Once this kind of physique is exposed, you will be competed by all the major forces. At that time, it will not be a matter of cultivation, but a matter of whether you can survive. No one will treat you as a human being, you will only be regarded as a tool that can make people break through."

    "Then what does Master plan to do?"

    She was silent for a long time.

    Lin Chen looked at her and waited.

    She stood there motionless, only her fingers were trembling slightly.

    Finally, she spoke, her voice a little hoarse.

    "I have been trapped in the late stage of Jindan for six years. I have used countless methods and taken countless pills in the past six years, but I have never been able to break through. The hidden injury on my left shoulder was left from a fight six years ago. Not only has it not healed over the years, it has become more and more serious. The spiritual energy in the Dantian is also becoming more and more stagnant."

    "If this continues, the journey of being a teacher will come to an end."

    She raised her head and stared straight at him.

    "Lin Chen, I need your help as a teacher."

    "Of course my disciple is willing to help Master, but..."

    Lin Chen paused.

    "When Master talks about help, does he mean dual cultivation?"

    Yu Linglong's face turned slightly red.

    She was used to a cold image. She had been an elder in Cangwu Sect for twenty years, and others had always spoken to her respectfully.

    It is indeed a bit difficult for her to say those words in person now.

    "yes."
